column1: ### 🪦 TOMBSTONE — THIS FILE IS NOT DATA. DO NOT READ IT AS TSV. DO NOT WRITE TO IT.
The Job Market state was split into one file per role lane on 2026-08-04.
routines/job-market-state/<role_id>.tsv     one per entry in job-market-roles.json roles[]
routines/job-market-state/_unfiled.tsv      qualifying finds with no lane yet
routines/job-market-state/_MIGRATION.md     the design, the rules, and why
Read _MIGRATION.md first. It carries the cross-listing rule (one listing = one row = one
home file, never two), the _unfiled discipline, and the open questions the split did not settle.
WHY: this file reached 25,403 bytes against a ~22KB read-truncation ceiling. A truncated read
followed by a full-file write silently destroys rows. Splitting also made per-role commits
affordable, which is what killed the practice of passing TSV deltas between sessions as prose
in a CHECKPOINT comment. See routines/job-market-refresh.md v17.
The last combined version is intact in git at commit 16bb42b (108 rows).
Kept as a stub rather than deleted so stale pointers resolve to this explanation instead of a 404.
